evidence_limits: Original material comes from the pinned repository. New files only extract or capture existing content and record verification; no experiments or checker execution were performed.
True fan votes are unobserved; fan shares and popularity are model estimates, not recovered ground truth.
fan_shares_estimated.csv and panel_with_eta_decomp.csv are named in source but absent from the pinned repository tree.
All four problem notebooks have no saved output cells at this commit; no new notebook execution was performed.
The rule-comparison image averages per-season accuracies. Its error bars are population standard deviations across seasons (np.nanstd in plot_gap_and_overall_combined), not confidence intervals.
Rounded image labels around 0.63/0.77/0.59 and report prose 0.645/0.766 are not interchangeable exact raw data; no points or exact errors were digitized from the image.
performance.png is an existing simulation figure; it does not prove causal fairness or real deployment performance.
